mapper.select:
SELECT rf.rfv_num AS rfvNum, rf.user_num AS userNum, rf.rcp_num AS rcpNum,
r.rcp_name AS rcpName, r.rcp_way AS rcpWay, r.rcp_type AS rcpType, r.rcp_weight AS rcpWeight, r.rcp_kcal AS rcpKcal, r.rcp_carbs AS rcpCarbs, r.rcp_protein AS rcpProtein, r.rcp_fat AS rcpFat, r.rcp_natrium AS rcpNatrium, r.rcp_image AS rcpImage, r.rcp_parts AS rcpParts,
rf.rfv_created_at AS rfvCreatedAt
FROM recipe_favorites rf
JOIN recipe r ON rf.rcp_num = r.rcp_num
WHERE rf.user_num = #{userNum}
ORDER BY rf.rfv_created_at DESC
